explanation:
Volta (V100) introduced Tensor Cores; Ampere (A100) added asynchronous global-to-shared copies and TF32/BF16; Hopper
(H100) added TMA, clusters, warpgroup MMA and FP8; Blackwell (B200) added Tensor Memory, single-thread MMA issue and
FP4/FP6 with hardware block scaling. Pascal (P100) had no Tensor Cores.
